description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three different sentiment analysis tools across two categories of text data. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis", and displays two groups from left to right: "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy", using a linear scale that ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 with major tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2 and minor tick marks at 0.1 intervals; a small grey shaded rectangle is annotated on this axis just above the 0.4 mark. The chart features grouped bars, with each category containing three side-by-side bars representing different tools, as defined by a legend in the bottom right corner. According to the legend, "TEXTBLOB" is represented by white bars with black outlines, "VADER" by white bars with black diagonal hatch lines and black outlines, and "ChatGPT" by solid green bars. For the "Emoji Tweets" category, the TEXTBLOB bar is the shortest in the chart at approximately 0.32, the VADER bar is roughly 0.46, and the ChatGPT bar is the tallest overall at approximately 0.67. For the "Overall Tweet" category, the TEXTBLOB bar reaches about 0.40, the VADER bar is near 0.47, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 0.66. The bars within each group are not sorted by height but follow a consistent left-to-right order of TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, with the solid green ChatGPT bars visually standing out against the uncolored, outlined, and hatched bars of the other two methods against a background of dash-dot grid lines.
